name: NGC 4690 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4690, a slowly rotating early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4690-hubble
story: The stars of this galaxy circle its center only slowly, and Hubble's sharp view found no flattened core at its heart. Astronomers think galaxies like it were assembled in a different way than slow rotators that do have cores.

claims.text: NGC 4690 is one of the 12 slowly rotating early-type galaxies imaged in program 13324
NGC 4690's nuclear light profile is core-less
Cored and core-less slow rotators assembled through different processes
Program 13324 targets early-type galaxies with low angular momentum
